message: I once found myself in the middle of a blackout, feeling a bit like a gloriously over-prepared scout. I had my trusty flashlight, a lantern, and a power bank all ready to go, while my neighbors were fumbling in the dark. It turned into an impromptu outdoor gathering as I shared some snacks and light with them—who knew being prepared could turn a blackout into a cozy evening? What’s your favorite way to stay comfortable when the lights go out?
